title: 第17章 戏耍宗门弟子第18章 洞府深处
content_zh:
“可惜了，没能打起来！”
楚峰脸上露出一丝失望之色。
秦诗瑶和吴杰两人在各自宗门师兄的劝解下和解了。
随后楚峰将目光看向了大殿中的那十几个洞室。
这些洞室外面同样有着阵法保护。
而且，阵法等级颇高！
足足有种三品中级层次。
“老庞，这里有没有好东西？”
楚峰问道。
“都是一些中品法器，对老子没多大用处，对你倒是有些用处。
不过，我建议你还是不要将时间浪费在这上面了！
而且，一旦被他们发现，我们的计划恐怕就泡汤了。”
楚峰看了看那些洞室，面露遗憾之色。
两人继续深入！
再往里面深入，就要面对三品中高级阵法了。
这一路赶来，两人都有所消耗。
“老庞，你手里有没有灵石，我需要补充一番！
不然，我隐身不了多久了。”
楚峰体内的造化之力的确消耗颇大。
他没有注意到，此刻，庞烈的鞋子已经露了一点出来，恰好就在脚踝下方一点。

而这一幕，恰好被一位宗门弟子发现了。
于是他惊呼了一声。
“看，那一双鞋子在跑，那一定是诞生了灵智的灵器！”
其他人听闻，立刻将目光看向楚峰和庞烈两人所在之处。
“是真的，能够自主跑动，肯定是诞生了灵智的灵器！”
这一刻，所有的宗门弟子都不约而同的朝着楚峰和庞烈两人追了过去。
“嗯？发生了何事？他们怎么忽然都朝这边冲了过来？”
楚峰和庞烈两人很快便察觉到了三大宗门弟子的异样。
“他们说这里有一双灵器鞋子，老庞，你找找看，在哪里？
如果我们能够得到，就更有把握与三大宗门长老抢夺宝物了。”
楚峰提醒道。
灵器啊，他也眼馋的很！
庞烈也满脸期待，然而，等他将精神力散发出去的时候，什么也没有发现。
“没有啊！”
庞烈心中疑惑。
就在这时，他忽然感觉到自己的脚被人抓住了。
“我抓到灵器鞋子了！”
一位云天宗的弟子忽然大声叫道。
“什么鬼？竟然抓着老子的鞋子当作灵器！
给老子滚开！”

庞烈的脚被人抓住，下意识他便一脚踢出。
那位抓住庞烈双脚的宗门弟子被一脚踹中，整个人如同皮球一样倒飞了出去。
content_en:
"It's a pity that we couldn't fight!"
A look of disappointment appeared on Chu Feng's face.
Qin Shiyao and Wu Jie reconciled under the persuasion of their respective sect brothers.
Then Chu Feng looked at the dozen caves in the hall.
The outside of these caves is also protected by formations.
Moreover, the formation level is quite high!
It is enough to reach the intermediate level of third grade.
"Old Pang, is there anything good here?"
Chu Feng asked.
"They are all medium-grade magic weapons. They are not of much use to me, but they are of some use to you.
However, I suggest you don’t waste your time on this!
Moreover, once they discover it, our plan may be ruined. "
Chu Feng looked at those cave rooms with a look of regret on his face.
The two of them continue to go deeper!
If you go deeper inside, you will face third-grade mid-to-high-level formations.
Along the way, both of them were exhausted.
"Old Pang, do you have any spiritual stones in your hand? I need to add some!
Otherwise, I won't be invisible for long. "
The power of creation in Chu Feng's body was indeed consumed a lot.
He didn't notice that at this moment, Pang Lie's shoes had been exposed a little, just below the ankle.
And this scene happened to be discovered by a sect disciple.
Then he exclaimed.
"Look, those shoes are running, they must be the spiritual weapon that gave birth to spiritual intelligence!"
When the others heard this, they immediately looked towards where Chu Feng and Pang Lie were.
"It's true. Being able to run independently must be the birth of a spiritual weapon with intelligence!"
At this moment, all the sect disciples chased Chu Feng and Pang Lie in unison.
"Huh? What happened? Why did they all rush over here suddenly?"
Chu Feng and Pang Lie soon noticed something strange about the disciples of the three major sects.
"They said there is a pair of magic shoes here, Lao Pang, look for it, where are they?
If we can get it, we will be more confident in snatching the treasure from the elders of the three major sects. "
Chu Feng reminded.
He is also very greedy for spiritual weapons!
Pang Lie was also full of expectations. However, when he released his spiritual power, he found nothing.
"No!"
Pang Lie was confused.
At this moment, he suddenly felt his feet being grabbed.
"I caught the magic weapon shoes!"
A disciple of Yuntian Sect suddenly shouted loudly.
"What the hell? You actually grabbed my shoe and used it as a spiritual weapon!
Get out of my way! "
Pang Lie's foot was grabbed, and he subconsciously kicked it out.
The sect disciple who grabbed Pang Lie's feet was kicked and his whole body flew backwards like a ball.
